name: Change Impact Analysis Agent — core scenarios
description: Benchmarks the end-to-end pipeline against a high-risk breaking-API scenario (must trigger HITL governance) and a low-risk additive scenario (must not trigger HITL governance).

parts.text: Analyze change impact for issue_number 512 in repo acme-corp/billing-service. The issue requests removing the `legacy_customer_id` field from the /v1/invoices response and replacing it with `customer_ref`.

Change Impact Assessment published: risk_level=High, requires_human_approval=true, impact:high-risk label applied, @tech-lead-review tagged for sign-off due to a breaking API contract change on /v1/invoices.

Analyze change impact for issue_number 88 in repo acme-corp/notifications-service. The issue requests adding an optional `preferred_locale` field to the user preferences table, defaulting to 'en-US', with no changes to existing API responses.
Change Impact Assessment published: risk_level=Low, requires_human_approval=false, finops_cost_impact=Low (<$50/mo), no breaking changes identified.
